Class ScoreManager

java.lang.Object
backend.logic.ScoreManager
public class ScoreManager extends Object
Manages persistence and retrieval for the global high score table.

This class wraps FileDataStore to load and save HighScoreTable data from persistent storage. It exposes convenience methods for recording new scores and retrieving leaderboard entries for a specific stage or mode.
